description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing products in a Vue.js application, including state initialization and actions for adding, updating, and deleting products.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product to the store with a generated ID, creation timestamp, and active status.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product by its ID with specified property changes.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Removes a product from the store by its ID.
